title: Question NW7339 to the Minister of Basic Education
why_not: Says what LURITS is (learner enrolment data submitted by schools through provincial school administration systems and held in provincial data warehouses; 13 596 869 learners in 2025) but states no fact on a gap aspect that leads 5 and 6 do not: no school count, level, owner-and-funding or change in the year.
